comment: Overlay for sterile CLIENT exports (extends public_export_config.json). Public only: generic gates plus client-tree shape (excludes, fixture allowlists, workflow inventory, binary hashes). Literal private scrub rules live in the excluded private policy.
_note_scoping: Review #269: opaque-gate exceptions are per-gate and minimal. Pack manifests rotate on every update, so they keep path-scoped excepts (assigned+bare only: the only gates that fire there; backtick/quoted have no hits and stay fully armed). launcher.json keeps only a bare-path except (generated Adoptium manifest). The kiwi config key is a stable value, so it is allow_exact, \u-escaped mid-token: the raw overlay file is itself scanned by the workspace export, and the raw spelling is opaque-shaped, so the escape keeps the file self-clean while decoding to the exact key. f-app-suffix pins only the two synthetic hook fixtures as \u-escaped values (first char): raw spellings would trip the workspace pre-push identifier grep, and the escapes decode to the exact fixture strings. f-email-no-tld pins checkout@v4, t@t and the patch-context match as plain values (raw spellings verified clean against every other gate). Banned literal path exempts never cross targets: banned_token_word_paths re-declares the one reviewed word path shared with the client tree. Do not "clean up" the escapes.

stub_files..github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: Deploy client (stub)
# Sterile public export: production deployment stays private until it moves
# server-side (Blockfield/server#197); this stub keeps the client.yml
# reusable-workflow call valid so the exported tree lints self-contained.
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      tag: { required: true, type: string }
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - run: "echo deploy stub, no-op until Blockfield/server#197"
